name: ttt_big

gate_vs_damage.damage_measure: mean total variation over all live positions

same_removals_scored_as_KL.note: KL at the read position, the quantity the ratchet lane uses for edit cost. A TV and a KL are NOT the same number and must not be compared across lanes as if they were.

why_game_outcome_is_not_the_test: Tic-tac-toe is easy; a cut net can still draw every game without copying the gates. The random-cut null, the function agreement on one-best positions, and the gate-versus-damage correlation are what can tell those apart.
